latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the AI Trading Card Generator skill.
- Generate custom collectible card art in MTG, Pokemon, Yu-Gi-Oh, and sports card styles.
- Supports card types including fantasy TCG, spell, character, and monster cards.
- Features ornate borders, painterly compositions, and foil-style finishes.
- Integration with Neta AI image generation API (token required).
